thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — I'm flying out tomorrow, can't cover primary 2026-03-14 12:00 UTC -> 20:00 UTC. Can @Maya take primary for that window? I'll stay reachable for critical pages until 13:00 UTC.
Maya: I can take primary from 12:00–18:00 UTC but have a meeting 18:00–19:00 UTC. Need someone to cover 18:00–19:00 as secondary? @Sam are you available for that hour? :wave:
Sam: Yup available 18:00–19:30 UTC to cover the meeting. I'll be on phone and Slack. Do we need to update PagerDuty rotation?
Alex: Yes please. PagerDuty rotation needs a one-off swap — @Jin can you run the pd override? Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/oncall-handoff (internal). Handoff checklist:
```
- confirm pd override
- post handoff in #eng-oncall
- run quick smoke: curl -s https://status.redwood/api/health
- verify canary model endpoints (t5-quant) serving
- leave note in incident doc
```
Jin: on it. I'll apply override for Maya as primary 12:00–18:00 and Sam 18:00–19:30. ping me 11:50 UTC if you haven't seen it.
Incident Bot: Automated note: No active Sev1/Sev2 incidents. Current oncall: Alex(primary), Jin(secondary).
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty override applied by Jin — schedule now: Maya (12:00–18:00 UTC), Sam (18:00–19:30 UTC), Alex (fallback). Link to override: https://pd.example/override/abC123
Maya: Got it. Quick question — does Dedicated cluster alpha have scheduled maintenance at 17:30 UTC? If so, we should move Sam earlier.
Alex: There is a short rolling maintenance 17:25–17:40 on alpha GPU nodes for drivers. It's low-risk but I can shift my availability to 13:00–18:30 if that helps.
Sam: If Alex can cover until 18:30 that removes the gap. Alex — can you confirm you'll be reachable until 18:30?
Alex: Yes I can extend to 18:30 but then I'm offline 18:30–19:30. So final plan: Maya primary 12:00–17:30, Alex 17:30–18:30 (fallback), Sam 18:30–19:30. :thumbsup:
Maya: Acknowledged. I'll post runbook pointers in the handoff doc and DM the SRE pager number. Also leaving these quick commands for checks:
```
# health
curl -fS https://status.redwood/api/health || echo 'health fail'
# canary logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=canary --tail=200
```
Sam: Thanks — I'll be on standby. Leaving my mobile: +1-555-0133. Ping me with urgent pages.
Jin: override updated accordingly. I also set a temporary auto-escalation to Jin (secondary) if pages go unanswered >5m.
Incident Bot: Note added to thread: 'one-off override + maintenance window'.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll create a quick post-handoff note in the schedule doc after I land.
